title: Construction contracts.
bodyText: The development corporation shall award construction contracts in conformity with chapter 103D and this chapter.
bodyHtml: §206J-9  Construction contracts.  The development corporation shall award construction contracts in conformity with chapter 103D and this chapter. [L 1981, c 236, pt of §1; ree L 1986, c 146, §6; am L Sp 1993, c 8, §54]
